context.body: A future catastrophe that Noah cannot yet see becomes a long sequence of concrete work.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: God tells Noah that violence has brought an end to all flesh, then specifies the ship, its rooms, dimensions, covering, occupants, animals, and food.
observations.label: Noah receives warning and ship instructions: action

observations.body: Noah does everything God commands after receiving a covenant announcement about entering with his household.
observations.label: Noah receives warning and ship instructions: response

observations.body: end to all flesh · make a ship · establish my covenant · thus Noah did
observations.label: Words in Genesis 6:13–22

payload.posture: Read Genesis 6:13–22 as warning and the ship evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage records Noah’s complete obedience but gives neither his speech nor his inner reasoning.
payload.title: Noah receives warning and ship instructions
